author: sarah_m
content: Wonderful place to work! The team is incredibly supportive and the café has a great atmosphere. Accommodation was basic but comfortable — everything you need. Highly recommend for anyone looking for a first hospitality experience in Bangkok.

author: tom_travels
content: Good experience overall. Gets very busy during peak hours but you learn fast. Manager is fair and communicates well. Staff meals on shift are a big plus — saves a lot on food costs.

author: diver_ana
content: Best dive school I've worked for. Very professional set-up, beautiful dive sites, and the team genuinely feels like family. The accommodation is simple but the island life more than makes up for it.

author: fins_n_bubbles
content: Fantastic season here. Equipment is well-maintained, management respects instructors' time off, and guests are genuinely enthusiastic. Would return without hesitation.

author: yogi_jules
content: The bungalow and food were exceptional — fresh, organic, and absolutely delicious. Great guests, peaceful environment, and the owner is deeply committed to authentic practice. A transformative experience.

author: teacher_k
content: Professional school with great admin support. Students are motivated and the lesson materials are solid. The apartment provided was lovely. Communication before arrival could be improved.

author: earthworm_erin
content: Really special place for anyone wanting a taste of sustainable farming. Hard work but incredibly rewarding. The cabin is rustic but the mountains and stars at night are unbeatable.
